shape_hint: Flat round washer with a plain circular hole; the outer rim is cut into many radial teeth (external teeth, Form A) that are twisted alternately up and down out of the plane so the washer looks like a toothed star in plan view and slightly wavy in side view.

notes: Scope: Form A (external teeth) of DIN 6797 and DIN 6798 only. Forms J (internal teeth), V (countersunk external teeth) and ASME B18.21.1 / KS B 1325 not verified. d1/d2/s are identical in both DIN standards; the teeth counts differ (6798 A has more teeth). d1 is the minimum (=nominal) inner diameter, tolerance H13; d2 maximum (=nominal) h14. Thread label is the screw size the washer is made for (d1 10.5 = M10 etc.). M12, M14, M16 rows are missing on purpose: pages disagree whether d1 is 13/15/17 or 12.5/14.5/16.5 (maintainer must check the standard). Some manufacturers (beneri, damesa) also sell own variants 6.18/10.9, 8.2/14, 12.6/20.22, 16.5/26; those are not the DIN series. schrauben-lexikon states both forms correspond to no ISO standard; whether DIN 6797/6798 are formally withdrawn was not verified.
